doc: Rows the adaptive daily layer adds (day-plan, owner decisions 2026-10-06 D1-D5). Minutes, set caps, max_lifts and primary_min_sets are NOT copied here: daily_plan.load_rules() reads them from compose_rank_rules.json (budget / set_caps / trainer_fit). Readiness thresholds are not copied either: they are the kit's STATE_RECOVERING / STATE_HARD, passed in by the caller. Values are provisional practitioner heuristics (spec grade C-D) except where the spec names an owner decision.

pain_site_muscles.doc: An open pain event on a site blocks the muscles that site moves (provisional, practitioner grade D; the caution filters stay the safety source).
